findings.description: The loop now removes only param.opts from the help option names and no longer removes param.secondary_opts, which the old code also excluded.
findings.rationale: If a parameter declares a secondary option that matches a help option name, for example click.option('--foo/--help'), the old code excluded '--help' from the help names but the new code keeps it. The help option is then generated with a name already used by another parameter, so the conflict the old code avoided can reappear. This needs a parameter whose secondary option collides with a help option name, which is uncommon.
